scope: Search, answer-engine, generative-engine, entity-presence, crawler-governance, structured-data, freshness, and measurement rules used by website-skills.
archive_policy: Existing archives are recorded where found. Creating new third-party archives was outside this operation; missing archive evidence is NOT_ASSESSED.

sources.title: Optimizing your website for generative AI features on Google Search

sources.title: Generative AI performance report (Search)

sources.title: From Citation Selection to Citation Absorption
sources.scope_and_limit: Original empirical preprint separating citation selection from measured contribution; not a universal platform rule or production causal proof.

sources.title: Optimizing Visibility in Generative Engines: A Critical Survey of Generative Engine Optimization (2023-2026)
sources.scope_and_limit: Critical scoping review of heterogeneous evidence; preprint conclusions support caution, not a definitive cross-platform algorithm model.

claims.claim: For Google Search, AEO and GEO are third-party labels and generative AI optimisation remains grounded in SEO and core Search systems.
Google Search does not require llms.txt, special AI markup, artificial chunking, or AI-only writing for generative Search visibility.
Google provides a dedicated Search Console generative AI impressions report and a separate property inclusion control worldwide as of 31 August 2026.
Google deprecated HowTo rich results and stopped showing FAQ rich results from 7 May 2026.

support_review.basis: Google documentation change log and linked historical announcement

claims.claim: Bing AI Performance currently documents citations, average cited pages, sampled grounding queries, page-level activity, and trends, none of which is a ranking or authority metric.
OpenAI separates OAI-SearchBot search inclusion from GPTBot potential training, while ChatGPT-User is user-triggered and is not the search-inclusion control.

support_review.basis: Current OpenAI crawler and publisher documentation

claims.claim: Google's unauthenticated sitemap ping endpoint is deprecated; use sitemaps through robots.txt, Search Console, or its API and use truthful lastmod values.

AI citation selection, contribution to an answer, fidelity, referral, and business outcome are separate outcomes; current GEO evidence does not establish a stable universal cross-platform ranking recipe.

support_review.basis: Qualified synthesis of two original preprints
